name: Grape's Lilly Leapers
summary: Grape’s Lilly Leapers is a VR movement-based game where you use only your hands to run, jump, and leap across a swampy world filled with giant lily pads, mushrooms, and swampy trees. There are no sticks, no buttons—just pure momentum-based movement. Climb and bounce through the map while playing tag, mini-games, or just vibing with friends!
